purpose: Evaluate cost, service and emissions trade-offs for a modelled Chongqing-Guoyuan to Shanghai-Yangshan order portfolio under hard emissions targets.
evidence_boundary: Published corridor prices, service times, distances and mode emissions factors are read from the field-level facility model. Every order, release pattern and allocatable capacity below is a deterministic experiment assumption, not an observed booking, manifest, contract or current timetable.

policy_anchors.label: China 2030 transport-intensity anchor
policy_anchors.scope_limit: The policy states an economy-wide operating-transport carbon-intensity change from 2020, not a mandatory shipment-level cap for this corridor.

policy_anchors.label: IMO 2030 minimum absolute-GHG checkpoint used as a stress target
policy_anchors.scope_limit: The IMO checkpoint covers international shipping against 2008; this domestic multimodal experiment uses the percentage only as a transparent stress scenario.

policy_anchors.label: IMO 2030 striving checkpoint used as an ambitious stress target
policy_anchors.scope_limit: The target is not asserted as a legal requirement for Chongqing-Shanghai freight.

carbon_price_scope.limit: The 2025 national ETS record covers power, steel, cement and aluminium entities, not domestic freight as a directly covered compliance sector. The prices are model shadow prices.
